name: social-downloader-windows
title: Social Downloader
description: Download videos and playlists from social platforms, manage a batch queue, and convert local media on Windows.
author: victorhugoguimaraes

commands.name: download
commands.title: Download Social Media
commands.description: Inspect a link and choose video or audio quality and format

preferences.name: destination
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Defaults to your Windows Downloads folder

preferences.name: addLinkShortcut
preferences.title: Add Link Shortcut
preferences.description: For example Ctrl+N or Alt+N. Supports Ctrl, Alt, Shift plus a letter, number, or Backspace. Reopen the command after changing.

preferences.name: removeLinkShortcut
preferences.title: Remove Link Shortcut
preferences.description: Removes the last additional field. Use a different combination from Add Link. Reopen the command after changing.
